discrepancy_A_RMSE.question: Why is candidate RMSE 63.764094 W/m2 instead of earlier 64.230507 W/m2?
discrepancy_A_RMSE.explanation: 64.230507 W/m2 was the candidate RMSE under the refit Stage 4 baseline protocol (where Stage 4 parameters were fit on EVEN origins, producing Control RMSE 65.083569 W/m2). 63.764094 W/m2 is the candidate RMSE under the official globally frozen Stage 4 baseline protocol (where ensemble_parameters.json was used without refitting, producing Control RMSE 64.219495 W/m2). Both values are 100% deterministically reproducible under their respective baseline protocols.

discrepancy_B_bootstrap_mean.question: Why is bootstrap mean delta MAE -0.402099 W/m2 instead of earlier -0.413599 W/m2 for CI [-0.759039, -0.046315] W/m2?
discrepancy_B_bootstrap_mean.explanation: -0.413599 W/m2 (CI [-0.758142, -0.076533]) was the paired origin-level bootstrap mean under the refit Stage 4 baseline protocol. -0.402099 W/m2 (CI [-0.759039, -0.046315]) is the paired origin-level bootstrap mean under the official globally frozen Stage 4 baseline protocol (10,000 resamples, seed=42). The CI [-0.759039, -0.046315] belongs strictly and deterministically to the -0.402099 W/m2 mean under the frozen protocol.
